note: Test keys only, made by protected40.py from fixed labels (stream(label, n): SHA-256 of the label and a 32-bit little-endian counter, concatenated). No SDK trusts them.
how: Plaintexts are stream(path, size). CDN form: payload = gzip_stored(plaintext) (stored deflate blocks of 65,535 bytes after the header 1f8b08000000000000ff, then CRC-32 and size), key = file_key(build_key, path), key_id = the build's. Device form: payload = the plaintext, key_id = the local key id, key = local_file_key(build_key, local key id, path). The build key is hkdf.json's. record_heads: each record's first 32 ciphertext bytes and its tag. `version`: the header's (2, with the notice field, is what writers write; the cases named v1 are the same containers with the 96-byte header readers still read).

accept.name: v1 device variant 3 (permutation and gap mark)

refuse.name: a flipped tag in the first record
a flipped tag in the middle record
a flipped tag in the last record
the last record dropped and payload_size set to two records
a record added (a copy of record 1)
the header's file_index changed (the manifest says 2)
the container of another entry (the manifest says 3)
a device form where a CDN form is read
a raw payload in the CDN form
the notice: a byte that is not printable ASCII
the notice: empty (its first byte zero)
the notice: a byte after its zero padding
the notice: other printable words (the header is in every record's AAD)
a variant bit in the CDN form
a wrong path_hash (read as another path)
the plaintext is not the manifest's (decoded sha256)
the plaintext is not the manifest's (decoded size)

refuse_base.name: cdn gzip payload 3145727
refuse_base.ops: xor: data[offset] ^= value; set: write hex at offset; truncate: keep size bytes; append: add a copy of data[from:from+length]; append_hex: add the bytes; swap: exchange data[a:a+length] and data[b:b+length]; applied in order

refuse_v1.name: v1: a flipped tag in the middle record
v1: version 2 over a version 1 header (header_len 96)

refuse_device.name: a device form whose local key id was changed
